title: O Bless, Thou Heavenly Potentate
description: O Bless, Thou Heavenly Potentate in Tonic Solfa to OLD HUNDREDTH, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 300.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to OLD HUNDREDTH; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O bless, Thou heav-enly Po-ten-tate, With wis-dom, strength, the powers of state, That wrong and vi-o-lence may cease And Church and home a-bide in peace.

lines: With wisdom, strength, the powers of state,
That wrong and violence may cease
And Church and home abide in peace.
Bless rich and poor, the great and small,
Both friend and foe; Lord, bless Thou all
The family on earth in love
And fit all for Thy home above.
Thus, with Thy blessing on each hand,
Will peace and plenty fill the land
And righteousness spring from the earth
And life below have higher worth.
All praise to Thee, O King of kings,
Whose grace to us such blessings brings;
Thee, with the Father, we adore,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1927.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to OLD HUNDREDTH by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
